newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strasbourg air cargo traffic up 6.8pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Strasbourg air cargo traffic up 6.8pct in 1996.

text.p: 1996 air cargo traffic handled at Strasbourg-Entzheim airport totalled 6,492 tonnes, up 6.8 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.

Air Jet, airline subsidiary of French express distribution company, Jet Services, operates a nightly air cargo service between Strasbourg and Paris/CDG with British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) aircraft.
Postal traffic totalled 5,064 tonnes, an increase of 0.8 percent on 1995 levels.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Strasbourg on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 7706
